corpus.title: IT 102 approved outline — revision 2026
corpus.text: IT 102 is Computer Programming 1. The approved 2026 outline covers variables and assignment in Week 1. Teaching uses a guided code trace. Assessment uses a short variable-declaration quiz. Weeks 9 and 18 are examination weeks.

corpus.title: IT 106 approved outline — revision 2026
corpus.text: IT 106 is Computer Programming 2. The approved 2026 outline covers object-oriented classes and encapsulation in Week 1. Assessment uses a class-design exercise. This outline does not replace IT 102.

corpus.title: IT 102 archived outline — revision 2025
corpus.text: Archived revision 2025 of IT 102 scheduled arrays in Week 1. This document is superseded. It is preserved for historical comparison and must not override the approved 2026 variables and assignment outline.

corpus.title: Academic access and approval policy
corpus.text: EduSuite is the system of record for course records, course loads and student rosters. A block holds up to 35 students. Dean review, CAO approval and EVP noting happen offline. Courseware is a draft until instructor review and explicit publication. Associate Dean accounts must not read student performance scores.
